marketDirection.headline: Indian market is advancing today.

reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed +0.38% at 25,387, above its 20-DMA, above the 50-DMA (rising), above the 200-DMA.
The index is up 1.4% over the last five sessions — uptrend structure intact.
Market breadth is cautious — 26.4% of scanned NSE stocks advancing, 42% above their 50-DMA.
Institutional absorption of the large secondary block triggers an immediate volume-expansion breakout above the ₹660 swing pivot.
Strong volume accumulation around the ₹815 support zone keeps the stock's multi-week ascending triangle pattern intact.

marketDirection.disclaimer: A rules-based read of index price, market breadth and headline flow — not a forecast or trading advice.

marketSummary: Nifty 50 retreated below the 25,250 mark after rejecting the 25,500 swing resistance hurdle, driven by broad-based profit taking in metals and consumer durables. While benchmark indices consolidated their 9% November post-Diwali surge, aggressive institutional participation continues, evidenced by over ₹53,000 crore in net FPI buying month-to-date and massive single-stock block deals. Capital goods and defense PSUs show strong relative strength within multi-week base consolidations, while consumer retail leader Trent and power equipment heavyweight CG Power hold firm above structural weekly pivot levels.
dailyFocus: Track base pullbacks and volume contraction near breakout retest zones across high-relative-strength counters (HAL, BEL, CGPOWER), while monitoring high-volume secondary action in block deal candidates like IIFL Finance and Ashoka Buildcon.

sectors.name: Defence & Aerospace
sectors.reason: Structural multi-year visibility backed by the ₹2.12 lakh crore DAC pipeline approval and consistent quarterly execution in tier-1 names like HAL and BEL.
catalysts: DAC procurement clearances with 82%+ domestic manufacturing mandate
Acceleration in GE F404 engine deliveries for LCA Tejas Mk1A
risks: Component supply chain delays and long lead delivery schedules
Rich headline valuation multiples leaving minimal cushion for execution misses

sectors.name: Power Infrastructure & Capital Goods
sectors.reason: Transmission capex tailwinds and industrial automation demand driving accelerating order book momentum (up 58% YoY in bellwethers like CG Power).
catalysts: Grid modernization investments and private industrial capex expansion
Switchgear and transformer capacity additions across Tier-1 vendors
risks: Raw material volatility in copper and electrical steel
Valuation compression if capex awards face state election pauses

sectors.name: Retail & Consumer Discretionary
sectors.reason: Selective outperformance driven by format expansion in value-apparel leaders offsetting broader urban consumption moderation.
catalysts: Operating leverage expansion across tier-2 and tier-3 formats
risks: Sluggish same-store sales growth in mature metros
Intensifying competitive discounting from regional players

sectors.name: Banking & Financial Services
sectors.reason: PSU lenders and top private banks are preserving the Nifty floor, though non-bank lenders face elevated slippages and block deal secondary supply.
catalysts: Strong institutional net inflows absorbing secondary market block deals
Stable asset quality among large-cap commercial banks
risks: NIM compression amidst competitive deposit mobilization
Unsecured retail credit headwinds affecting small NBFCs

sectors.name: Metals & Mining
sectors.reason: Widespread selling pressure on weak global steel and non-ferrous cues, dragging index breadth down on high volume.
catalysts: Potential safeguard import duties on domestic finished steel
risks: Soft Chinese demand and sliding base metal realisations
Persistent inventory destocking across primary producers

news.headline: IIFL Finance Surges 6% on Block Deal as Fairfax Offloads 13% Stake Ahead of IDBI Bank Bid
news.summary: Shares of IIFL Finance jumped 6.7% to ₹679.20 amid intense volume as a massive block deal of roughly 13% equity changed hands. Fairfax Financial Holdings is identified as the likely seller, liquidating shares to redeploy capital toward its controlling stake acquisition in IDBI Bank.
news.impact: Institutional absorption of the large secondary block triggers an immediate volume-expansion breakout above the ₹660 swing pivot.

news.headline: Motilal Oswal Upgrades CG Power Target to ₹1,140 as Order Inflows Surge 85% to ₹7,800 Crore
news.summary: Motilal Oswal reiterated a Buy call on CG Power with a revised target of ₹1,140 (40% upside), highlighting that Q2 order inflows rose 85% YoY to ₹78 billion, taking the cumulative backlog to ₹236 billion (+58% YoY) despite current rich valuation multiples (78x forward earnings).
news.impact: Strong volume accumulation around the ₹815 support zone keeps the stock's multi-week ascending triangle pattern intact.

news.headline: BEL Secures ₹909 Crore Additional Defence Orders; Added to UBS APAC Top Picks With ₹550 Target
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Ltd bagged additional defence orders worth ₹909 crore covering avionics, communication systems, and electronic warfare subsystems. UBS added BEL to its exclusive APAC list and raised its target price to ₹550, citing a swelling ₹1 lakh crore medium-term order pipeline.
news.impact: Repeated tests of ₹398-₹400 overhead resistance on elevated volume signal an imminent multi-month consolidation breakout.

news.headline: HAL Q2 Net Profit Grows 16% to ₹1,936 Crore; Management Guides 10 LCA Mk1A Deliveries by March 2027
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics reported a 16% YoY increase in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to ₹1,936 crore on 14.9% revenue growth to ₹7,613 crore. Management reaffirmed FY27 revenue growth of 10-12% with 30-31% EBITDA margins, noting 14 GE F404 engines received to deliver ~10 LCA Tejas Mk1A jets by March 2027.
news.impact: Stock consolidating above its 50-DMA; holding ₹4,700-₹4,750 preserves the multi-week cup base structure aiming for ₹5,100+ pivot highs.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Q2 Profit Drops 50% on Shipbuilding Drag; Secures ₹498.6 Crore INS Betwa Refit Contract
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard reported a 49.8% YoY drop in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹53.8 crore as the shipbuilding segment slipped into an operating loss, though the ship-repair vertical cushioned margins. The Ministry of Defence simultaneously awarded a ₹498.58 crore contract for the refit and re-powering of INS Betwa.
news.impact: Price action testing pivotal support at ₹1,100-₹1,130; requires high-volume stabilization to avoid a breakdown of its 6-month base.

news.headline: Nifty Slips Below 25,250 on Metals and Durables Drag After Hitting Fresh Swing High of 25,501
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices fell 500 points on the Sensex and over 150 points on the Nifty to close below 25,250 on November 18, facing technical resistance at the 25,500 milestone. Market breadth turned negative with over 2,200 decliners on the NSE, led by steep corrections in metal and consumer durable counters.
news.impact: Index pullback towards crucial dynamic support at 24,900-25,000 provides a healthy breather for trailing stops on existing swing longs.

news.headline: FPIs Pump ₹53,739 Crore Into Indian Equities in November on Global Non-AI Asset Diversification
news.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors turned aggressive net buyers in November 2026, deploying ₹53,739 crore into Indian equities. The inflows represent the strongest monthly foreign institutional buying since September 2024, sparked by capital rotation away from global mega-cap AI trades into high-growth domestic cyclicals.
news.impact: Sustained FPI institutional liquidity establishes a strong floor underneath large-cap breakout setups during market pullbacks.

news.headline: Trent Q2 Profit Climbs 25% to ₹468 Crore; Zudio Surpasses 1,000 Stores Milestone
news.summary: Trent Ltd posted a 25.3% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹468 crore with revenue surging 21.9% to ₹5,873 crore, led by aggressive physical expansion as Zudio officially surpassed the 1,000-store mark. Brokerages Elara Capital and Nuvama reiterated Buy ratings with targets up to ₹3,466.
news.impact: Constructive tight-range consolidation between ₹3,150 and ₹3,350 offers a low-cheat entry handle ahead of an all-time high base breakout.

news.headline: Defence Ministry's ₹2.12 Lakh Crore DAC Procurement Approval Sets Multi-Year Runways for HAL and BEL
news.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council cleared mega procurement proposals worth ₹2.12 lakh crore, with over 82% sourced from domestic industry. Analysts flag HAL (fighter aircraft & upgrades) and BEL (avionics & radars) as prime multi-year beneficiaries as commercial contracting begins over coming quarters.
news.impact: Reaffirms the institutional structural bid for primary aerospace contractors, keeping swing pullbacks in defence names well-supported.

news.headline: Ashoka Buildcon Attracts Heavy Buying in NSE Bulk Deals by HRTI and QE Securities
news.summary: Ashoka Buildcon logged heavy trading volume on November 18, rising over 4% after institutional proprietary firms HRTI Private Limited and QE Securities LLP purchased over 3.25 million shares in open-market bulk transactions at average prices of ₹114 per share.
news.impact: High-volume intraday pop above ₹112 tests the neckline of an inverse head-and-shoulders base; watch for follow-through above ₹115.
